p1: [low, ominous] In nineteen sixty-six, two men were found dead on a hill in Brazil... [whispers] with masks made of lead over their eyes.
[low] A young man flying a kite found them... lying side by side.
[low] Two electronics technicians... in suits and raincoats.
[low] Days earlier, at a bar in Niteroy, one of them bought a bottle of water... [low, tense] and kept checking his watch.
[low] Beside the bodies: the empty bottle, towels... [low, ominous] and a notebook.
[low, slow] Sixteen thirty, be at the agreed place. [low] Eighteen thirty, swallow capsules. After effect, protect metals. [whispers] Wait for mask signal.
[low, cold] No injuries. No sign of a struggle.
[low] The bodies had decayed too much to test for poison. [low, ominous] The cause of death was never found.
[low] People close to them said they were into... scientific spiritualism.
[low, tense] What capsules? What signal? [low] Sixty years later... [whispers] nobody knows.
